submitted.rationale: Index 0 (Sb 0.22, Zn 0.78) gave the only positive EQE, 0.00069%. Its composition sits at the Zn7Sb2O12 end of the line. XRD at Sb 0.42, 0.68 and 0.81 shows the same rutile/trirutile ZnSb2O6-type pattern across the line. That phase has a wide band gap, so it absorbs little at 2.1 eV, which fits the near-zero EQE at the Sb-rich points.
